SYNTHETIC TEST JOB DESCRIPTION — Observability and Platform Engineer
Company: Example Platform Labs (fictional)
Location: Boston / Remote, United States

Responsibilities and selection priorities
Build developer tooling for observable Node.js services. Instrument OpenTelemetry traces, expose Redis queue health signals, compare deployment runs, and analyze PostgreSQL latency. Package with Docker and automate GitHub Actions CI/CD on AWS. Favor monitoring, tracing, debugging, reproducible Linux environments and cache benchmarking over unrelated UI and algorithm work.

Required qualifications
- OpenTelemetry
- Docker
- AWS
- GitHub Actions
- CI/CD
- Redis
- Linux

Preferred, not mandatory
- Kubernetes
- Terraform

Applications are assessed on demonstrated work. Candidates may apply without preferred tools. Do not claim skills you have not used.
